facts.fact: ARTF, Congo's money-transfer regulator, said it will enforce from January 2027 the finance law's obligation on every money-transfer and exchange operator to register on its digital platform and use electronic payment terminals; the law is called 'en vigueur', and the article gives no year for the finance law.

systems.system: ARTF digital platform and electronic payment terminals (TPE)
systems.country_label: plateforme digitale de l'ARTF; terminaux de paiement électronique
systems.owner: ARTF (Agence de régulation des transferts de fonds)

note: A money-transfer registration and tax-capture rule, not e-money or payment-provider licensing; no non-bank licence and no provider-to-provider connection rule is stated.
